summary: EarthFlow Estimator - A construction/earthwork estimation tool for heavy civil projects. Primary target is Severino Construction, with Simak Trucking & Excavating and Mark Haynes Construction as the top white-label / clone candidates after the primary target. The MVP should stay open for later modular rebranding while preserving Terra Vantage as the proprietary tool name.

leads.name: J Severino Construction
leads.fit_rationale: Primary target for Terra Vantage. Commercial, industrial, and municipal contractor specializing in site development, earthwork, and underground utilities. Uses Trimble GPS equipment and HCSS earthwork software already - Terra Vantage complements that stack and should remain the canonical first branding choice.

leads.name: Simak Trucking & Excavating, Inc.
leads.fit_rationale: Primary white-label / clone candidate after Severino. Strong fit because their excavation and aggregate hauling workflows map directly to an earthwork estimator and they already operate in the same regional market.

leads.name: Mark Haynes Construction
leads.fit_rationale: Primary white-label / clone candidate after Severino. Strong fit because the company specializes in heavy civil work, site development, and earthmoving, making it a high-value later branding target.

leads.name: Brobst Earthworks, LTD
leads.fit_rationale: Local Ashtabula-based earthwork contractor specializing in excavation, demolition, and land projects. Family-owned business serving Northeast Ohio. Perfect fit for EarthFlow Estimator to streamline their bidding process on earthwork and site development projects.

leads.name: Koski Construction Co.
leads.fit_rationale: Established Ashtabula contractor (since 1921) specializing in road construction, heavy highway work, and sewer projects. ODOT-certified contractor with earthwork and embankment capabilities. Would benefit from streamlined earthwork estimation for public works projects.
leads.source: The Blue Book, Chamber of Commerce, LinkedIn

branding_quality_assessment.brand_presence: Almost none - no logo, color palette, or typography tied to specific entity
generic_signals: No custom iconography or brand messaging
Highly modular layout suitable for white-labeling
branding_quality_assessment.white_label_readiness: Excellent - design is so generic it could be easily re-skinned for any construction firm
recommendations: Add construction company logo placeholder in header
Implement dynamic color theming (currently static orange accent)
Include footer with configurable contact information
Add subtle construction industry visual elements (equipment silhouettes, grid patterns)

site_improvements.issue: No brand identity or company name in header
site_improvements.suggested_fix: Add logo placeholder and configurable company name field

site_improvements.issue: No help/instruction tooltip for map drawing
site_improvements.suggested_fix: Add 'How to Draw' tooltip or guided tutorial
Implement local storage or backend project persistence
site_improvements.impact: Medium - improves workflow for multiple bids

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout_assessment: Excellent two-column split layout - control panel left, map visualization right. Balanced and professional dashboard feel. Centered container works well.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_assessment: Safe orange/black/white palette appropriate for construction industry. Orange conveys energy and caution. Dark mode map provides good contrast.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography_assessment: Clean sans-serif fonts prioritize readability. Good font weight differentiation between labels and values.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.component_quality: Well-styled inputs, sliders, and buttons with cohesive design system appearance. Estimate card appropriately highlighted.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.polish_level: High for MVP - map integration and card layout show professional polish. No obvious clipping or layout bugs.
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.whitespace_usage: Effective whitespace separates Location, Scope, and Estimate sections clearly.

whitelabel_potential.reasoning: The tool is essentially a pure utility with no branding baked into the core functionality. The orange accent color could easily be made configurable. The modular card-based layout is perfect for swapping logos, colors, and company names. Target market is clearly defined (earthwork/excavation contractors) making white-label positioning straightforward.

Add project save/export functionality for contractor workflow integration
